limitations: No GPU record residency, texture streaming, or native scene-index dispatch integration.
Request and window flat storage remains; no total peak-memory or request-allocation reduction claim.
Preparation byte counters are logical shared records versus equivalent flat records, not total copies or PCIe traffic.
Replay still reconstructs flat inputs for existing safety checks; worker reconstructs flat inputs before dispatch.
No multiworker, arbitrary-material, adaptive, production-scene or universal bitwise parity qualification.
